questions.question: When asked if people should pay taxes to Caesar, what did Jesus tell the Pharisees and Herodians?

answers.text: Give Caesar what is Caesar's and God what is God's
Give Caesar nothing and give it all to God
Pay Caesar first and give God what is left

questions.question: Jesus told the Sadducees that when the dead rise, people will still marry. True or false?
To show the Sadducees that the dead rise, Jesus pointed to which scene from the life of Moses?

answers.text: The crossing of the Red Sea

questions.question: When a scribe asked Jesus which commandment is the most important of all, what did Jesus say?

answers.text: Love the Lord your God with everything
Keep the Sabbath and make it holy
Bring your offerings to the temple
